_about: Approved feeds for the 'What's changing' page. filter=true keeps only items matching general work/education keywords. require (optional regex, case-insensitive) keeps only items matching it. exclude (optional regex) drops matching items, used to keep partisan politics off the page. tags (optional) are added to every item from that source. BLS and Stanford DEL are not here because BLS blocks automated requests and Stanford has no feed; their key items live in pinned.json.

sources.name: Military Times
sources.require: recruit\w*|enlist\w*|ASVAB|JROTC|ROTC|GI Bill|basic training|boot camp|bonus(es)?|military pay|pay raise|SkillBridge|transition(ing)? (to|into) civilian|(veterans?|service ?members?|troops)\W+(\w+\W+){0,6}(jobs?|employ\w*|careers?|hiring|apprentic\w*|skills|credential\w*)
